# Hepatobiliary

This folder contains diagnostic classifications for hepatobiliary conditions monitored alongside inflammatory bowel diseases in Denmark. It currently holds data on primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC), documenting regional patient distributions across the five Danish regions and tracking national incident and prevalent cases tied to specific quality indicators.

## Pages

- [[dk830f-primaer-skleroserende-kolangitis|DK830F Primær skleroserende kolangitis]] — Tracks the prevalence and regional distribution of primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) patients, including incident and prevalent case counts linked to Indikator 7.
